A useful detail before you paste

Moon-phase emoji may render with color and extra width. Crescent text symbols provide a smaller alternative but can still vary by font.

Click a symbol tile to copy the exact characters shown. Save a selection with the star; it stays on this device. If automatic copying is blocked, CopySprig opens a selection window so you can use your device’s copy command.

These are Unicode characters, not downloadable fonts. Appearance and accessibility vary by app, device and font. Keep essential text readable. What to know before pasting
